title: Audit Engagement Manager - Fund & Investment Audit
description: Vanguard is hiring an Audit Engagement Manager to join our Global Investment and Financial Audit Services (GIFAS) team! In this role you will oversee risk-based audit and consulting engagements across the Investment Lifecycle, including front (investment/portfolio management), middle (investment operations), and back (fund accounting and oversight) office. You’ll play a pivotal role in implementing audit strategy on key risk topics, collaborating closely with partners to drive improvements in control environments. We seek individuals with strong critical thinking, project management, and relationship-building skills who can communicate effectively, exercise sound judgment, and influence senior stakeholders. Responsibilities: Oversee the delivery of the audit and consulting engagements. Ensure the timely delivery of the highest quality work and value-add recommendations. Outline engagement scope, determine level of associated risk and analyze data to determine underlying root causes. Challenge established processes and controls to ensure they are adequate to mitigate risk. Perform work and analysis on complex technology areas. Communicate the status and results of assigned work to various levels of management. Influence management to act on recommendations to strengthen the control environment and make process improvements. Provide opinion on audit and consulting findings, ratings, and recommendations to management. Communicate expectations to team and provide meaningful feedback to help develop team members by identifying and communicating areas for improvement in a timely manner. Establish and maintain relationships with technology management across aligned division and risk partners. Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications: Minimum of five years related work experience preferably in the financial services industry, including asset management or banking. Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Advanced degree is a plus. Strong technical expertise in asset management, capital markets, and regulatory compliance is important; CIA, CPA, CFA, or FRM are preferred but not required Experience delivering internal audits, evaluating control effectiveness, and recommending improvements that support business objectives. Skilled in managing the day‑to‑day execution of audit engagements, fostering productive stakeholder relationships, and coaching junior staff. Data analytics literacy, with the ability to apply analytical techniques to extract actionable insights and drive informed decision-making. Effective communicator with strong problem-solving, documentation, and leadership skills. Special Factors Sponsorship Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.   • Maintenance of shipment files, records, and cash logs
  • Airline booking coordination and breakbulk processing
  • Customer service across phone/email for shipment updates, rates, and issue resolution

  • House and master bill entry and system updates

title: Senior Commercial & Contract Manager - Offshore Wind
description: Do you want to shape the commercial performance of one of Europe's largest offshore wind portfolios? At Vattenfall, there is a way. We are accelerating the transition towards a future powered by renewable energy. Within Business Area Wind, we develop, build and operate wind farms onshore and offshore across Europe. With more than 24 GW of offshore wind projects in development and a growing operational portfolio, this is your opportunity to influence the future of sustainable energy at scale. We are looking for a Senior Commercial & Contract Manager Offshore Wind to join our Commercial Operations team. In this position, you will play a leading role in protecting and creating value across Vattenfall's offshore wind assets. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will drive strategic commercial initiatives, lead high-impact negotiations and contribute to the development of commercial excellence across Offshore Wind Operations. You will operate at the intersection of Operations, Asset Management, Procurement, Legal, Finance and Engineering, helping to solve complex commercial challenges while strengthening the commercial maturity of the organisation. What will you do? As Senior Commercial & Contract Manager, you will provide commercial leadership across a portfolio of operational offshore wind assets and support the continuous development of commercial governance and best practices throughout Offshore Wind Operations. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring that major supplier relationships, contractual frameworks and commercial decisions contribute to safe, reliable and cost-efficient operations. Your main tasks and responsibilities: Act as the senior commercial and contractual partner for assigned offshore wind assets, supporting critical operational and strategic business decisions. Lead the commercial management of a portfolio of high-value operational contracts, ensuring performance, contractual compliance, risk mitigation, and value delivery throughout the contract lifecycle. Lead complex commercial negotiations, major contract amendments, claims, disputes, and other high-impact contractual matters with strategic suppliers and contractors. Drive commercial performance by identifying opportunities to improve contract outcomes, reduce lifecycle costs, manage risk, and strengthen supplier collaboration across the portfolio. Provide clear commercial, contractual, and financial recommendations that support robust decision-making and long-term asset value creation. Shape and continuously improve commercial governance, contract management standards, reporting, and best practices across Offshore Wind Operations. Coach and support commercial colleagues while acting as a subject matter expert for complex commercial and contractual issues across the business. Who are you? You are an experienced commercial professional who combines strong commercial judgement with the ability to influence complex business decisions. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing stakeholder interests and managing high-impact contractual matters in a large-scale operational environment. You enjoy working across functions and are recognised for your ability to build trust, challenge constructively and create sustainable business value. Next to this you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Law, Engineering, or a related discipline. Extensive experience in contract management, commercial management, procurement, supplier management, or a comparable commercial discipline. Proven success leading complex commercial negotiations and managing high-value supplier and service agreements within asset-intensive industries. Strong expertise in contract strategy, contract changes, claims management, dispute resolution, and commercial risk management. Experience within offshore wind, renewable energy, utilities, maritime, infrastructure, oil & gas, or other complex operational environments. The ability to influence senior stakeholders, build trusted relationships across functions, and translate complex commercial matters into practical business decisions. Native-level German and fluent English language skills, with the ability to lead negotiations, manage contractual discussions, and to operate effectively in an international environment. Location Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam or Kolding.

description: Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement réactif et en plein développement où vous pourrez mettre en valeur vos compétences techniques et vos qualités relationnelles : vous êtes prêt pour un nouveau challenge ! title: SVP Head of Market Data Engineering (C++)
description: Citi’s Equities Technology organization is seeking a hands‑on Senior Market Data Platform Engineer to join the Market Data Engineering team, focusing on the design and delivery of Citi’s next‑generation real‑time market data distribution platforms supporting global Equities trading, with a roadmap toward multi‑asset coverage over time. The role sits within a horizontal Market Data platform organization responsible for delivering accurate, deterministic, and low‑latency market data to a broad set of internal consumers, including Electronic Execution (Algo/SOR), Market Access, and analytics platforms. The senior engineer will be involved in hands‑on system design and implementation, contributing to architectural decisions and ensuring adherence to latency targets while treating data correctness and determinism as non‑negotiable engineering outcomes. This includes deep ownership of wire‑to‑consumer latency, performance measurement, regression control, and OS‑level optimization required to achieve predictable behavior at scale. This role requires close collaboration with trading desks, platform consumers, quantitative research, infrastructure, and regional teams globally. Alignment with global strategy and cross‑regional market coverage is a core part of the role. Prior experience with real‑time market data systems and exchange microstructure across global venues is essential. Build and evolve performance‑critical C++ components for market data ingestion, normalization, and fan‑out. Define and enforce platform standards for market data semantics, schemas, and correctness guarantees. Engineer the end‑to‑end wire‑to‑consumer hot path, with explicit focus on NUMA‑aware design, core pinning / CPU isolation, lock‑free concurrency, memory layout, and cache locality. Own operating‑system and runtime‑level optimizations, including Linux kernel and network tuning, IRQ affinity, threading models, and performance profiling. Ensure deterministic performance under burst load, packet loss, and volatile market conditions. Use Aeron (or equivalent) for high‑performance fan‑out and IPC, with hands‑on responsibility for driver configuration, transport selection, and tuning. Own Aeron back‑pressure behavior, loss/replay semantics, and performance diagnostics to meet latency and correctness targets. Own latency measurement and observability using histograms (p50/p95/p99/p99.9) and tail analysis; establish baselines and alerting on distribution shifts. Drive high standards in code quality, automated testing, and SDLC discipline, with particular emphasis on correctness and latency regression safety. Leverage Citi’s AI‑powered SDLC tooling to enhance productivity, code quality, and engineering effectiveness. Evolve Agile development practices and CI/CD pipelines, with a focus on shift‑left testing and safe, accelerated release cycles. Qualifications: 12+ years of hands‑on engineering experience building low‑latency, high‑throughput systems, with strong proficiency in modern C++. Prior experience designing or owning real‑time market data distribution platforms in a global financial institution (Equities required; multi‑asset a plus). Deep, hands‑on experience with UDP multicast in production environments, including loss, recovery, and operational behavior. Strong understanding of low‑latency techniques, including NUMA, core pinning / CPU isolation, IRQ affinity, kernel and network tuning, memory management, and cache locality. Production experience using Aeron, including transport/driver tuning, back‑pressure management, loss/replay semantics, and performance diagnostics. Demonstrated ownership of wire‑to‑consumer latency observability, including histograms, tail analysis, and regression detection. Strong understanding of exchange microstructure and regional market structure differences across global venues. Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and deliver in a fast‑paced, globally distributed environment. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to reason about and clearly explain complex systems to engineers, quants, and trading stakeholders. Education: Bachelor's degree / University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. ------------------------------------------------------ Job Family

Your role and responsibilities:

The Maintenance Manager leads all maintenance, reliability, and asset management activities for the Fort Smith manufacturing facility, driving equipment reliability, operational excellence, and manufacturing performance through a comprehensive Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) strategy. This role oversees the development and execution of Operator Preventive Maintenance (OPM), Preventive Maintenance (PM), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) programs, leveraging technologies such as condition monitoring, vibration analysis, thermal imaging, oil analysis, and CMMS tools to proactively prevent equipment failures.

The position fosters a reliability-focused culture by driving continuous improvement in key performance indicators including MTBF, MTTR, OEE, uptime, and maintenance costs. The Maintenance Manager leads Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) efforts and collaborates cross-functionally to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance while ensuring sustainable asset reliability and operational excellence.

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead and continuously improve maintenance, reliability, and TPM programs by implementing proactive, preventive, predictive, and operator-driven maintenance strategies that maximize equipment performance and uptime.
  • Drive asset reliability and operational excellence through CMMS analytics, reliability metrics (MTBF, MTTR, OEE), root cause failure analysis, lifecycle planning, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
  • Manage maintenance operations, resources, and budgets by optimizing planning and scheduling, developing technical talent, controlling costs, and ensuring effective support for capital projects and facility growth.
  • Ensure safe, compliant, and efficient plant operations by meeting regulatory and corporate requirements, supporting plant performance objectives, and leading maintenance response to critical equipment and operational issues.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with minimum 10 years OR Associate’s Degree with minimum 12 years OR High School Diploma with minimum 14 years of maintenance experience working in a manufacturing environment. Including hands-on troubleshooting of PLCs, industrial controls, electrical and mechanical systems, and automated production equipment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in TPM, Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), asset management, and proactive maintenance programs, including OPM, PM, PdM, and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA).
  • Strong knowledge of predictive maintenance technologies and reliability methodologies, including vibration analysis, thermography, ultrasound, oil analysis, condition monitoring, and reliability KPI management (MTBF, MTTR, OEE, uptime).
  • Experience utilizing CMMS platforms (SAP preferred) for maintenance planning, scheduling, resource management, reliability analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proven leadership in automated manufacturing environments, with the ability to develop teams, drive cultural change, manage budgets and capital projects, and deliver operational excellence.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure ABB Pinetops has the necessary capabilities to effectively control products and systems. Each day, you will ensure compliance with internal, customer, and industry requirements within a cost-effective and safe working environment. Overseeing the test, inspection, and technician teams, you will control quality with systems, tools and teams to exceed expectations while ensuring sustainable operations and only compliant products are released to the customer.

Reporting to the Plant Quality Manager, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the 2nd and 3rd shift quality testing, inspection and technician teams which support production. Your hours will primarily be 2nd shift (roughly 2:30PM - 12AM). You will manage all aspects in line with guidance from ABB Group/division/business area.

The work model for the role is: onsite (#Li-Onsite) and will support the second and third shifts.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Assessing risks and safety hazards and implementing plans to ensure personnel and equipment safety

  • Collaborating with HR to ensure that the quality team is staffed, developed, directed, and accountable while ensuring effective training and cross training of employees. Enabling and coaching all employees to evaluate risks, problems and solutions from a customer/stakeholder point of vie

  • Focusing on preventing issues rather than just control, and driving the utilization of process management to deliver consistent results. Identifying and recommend process and equipment improvement opportunities, implement projects

  • Performing audits and ensuring the use of analytics to identify risks, failures and non-conformances, and ensuring that appropriate action is taken. Preventing mistakes and defects in products and avoiding problems when delivering solutions or services to customers

Qualifications for the role

  • A Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field or equivalent is preferred

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality, Manufacturing, or Engineering

  • As this role will manage 25 direct reports, prior supervisory or management experience is required

  • Sound knowledge of quality tools including RCA, 8D, and CAPA and sound knowledge of test techniques, voltage and current testing equipment (current power and protection market) is a plus

  • Knowledge of SAP, Microsoft Office, and Power BI are a plus

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills

  • Understanding of ISO 9001:2015 requirements and familiarity with IEEE standards, UL Requirements and SAP strongly preferred

  • Candidates must already possess authorization to work for ABB in the US.

About ABB Distribution Solutions in Pinetops, NC:

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid.

The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

What's in it for you:

We give you the space to lead, the support to grow, and the chance to make a difference.

title: Försäkringsrådgivare till Sparbanken Alingsås
description:
Nu tar vi nästa steg inom försäkring och pension och förstärker med en ny roll som försäkringsrådgivare. Du blir en del av vårt team med försäkringsspecialister och får vara med och utveckla försäkringsaffären vidare. Här kombinerar du din kompetens med affärsdriv och förmågan att få både kunder och kollegor att lyckas.

Du arbetar proaktivt med rådgivning inom försäkring och pension och utvecklar långsiktiga kundrelationer. Genom att förstå kundens situation, behov och mål hittar du relevanta lösningar och ser nya affärsmöjligheter.

Men jobbet handlar inte bara om din egen affär. Du arbetar nära våra rådgivare och kontor, delar med dig av din kompetens och hjälper andra att se och ta vara på möjligheter hos sina kunder. Tillsammans skapar ni bättre kundmöten och utvecklar affären.

Rollen innebär bland annat att du:

· Ger rådgivning inom försäkring och pension.

· Arbetar proaktivt med befintliga kunder och nya affärsmöjligheter.

· Stöttar rådgivare i kunddialogen och bidrar till att utveckla deras affär.

· Delar kunskap och stärker kompetensen inom området.

· Bygger starka relationer med både kunder och kollegor.

· Bidrar till att utveckla försäkringsaffären och nå våra gemensamma mål.

Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som kan försäkring och pension och som gillar att skapa affärer tillsammans med andra. Du tar initiativ, skapar förtroende och har lätt för att bygga relationer både internt och externt.

Du ser möjligheter, delar med dig av det du kan, och tycker att det är lika viktigt att lyfta andras framgångar som att lyckas med din egen. Har du erfarenhet av en liknande roll i en annan bank ser vi det som en stor fördel.

Du ska ha Swedsec rådgivarlicens och erfarenhet inom försäkringsförmedling är meriterande.

Vilka vi är
Du blir en del av Private Banking, där vi möter kunder med komplexa behov och som ställer höga krav på rådgivningen.

På Sparbanken Alingsås arbetar vi nära kunderna och nära varandra. Vi vill förstå människan bakom ekonomin, göra det komplexa enklare och använda vår kompetens för att skapa värde över tid.

Här får du möjlighet att påverka och bidra med det du kan. Tillsammans med kollegor som vill framåt är du med och utvecklar både kundmötet och vår affär.

tapki dalimi tarptautinės profesionalios komandos, įgyvendinančios iššūkių reikalaujančius projektus, didinančios klientų vertę ir Swedbank konkurencinį pranašumą.“ Swedbank komanda.

Merrill’s Financial Advisors and Wealth Management Client Associates help clients pursue the life they envision through a personal relationship with their advisory team committed to their needs. We believe trust comes from transparency. Our trusted advisory teams are equipped with access to the investment insights of Merrill coupled with the banking convenience of Bank of America. As a Financial Solutions Advisor within the centralized segment of the Advisor Development Program, your journey begins by obtaining your Securities Industry licenses, where you receive dedicated and personalized classes for your Securities Industry Essentials [SIE], Series 7 and Series 66 Exams. Once you obtain your licenses, you will be taught the foundational skills needed to be an advisor – from acquiring, building and managing client relationships to considering a client’s complex financial picture and guiding them with advice and solutions to help them live their best financial lives, all while humanizing financial interactions. You will then join the centralized team as a Financial Solutions Advisor. The Financial Solutions Advisors in the centralized segment are phone-based licensed advisors (obtaining series 7 and 66 required) that provide clients with holistic financial advice and guidance by identifying broader product and service solutions that meet their investment, savings and liability management solutions. FSA’s demonstrate knowledge of investments and financial markets and apply key principles appropriate to the individual client's investment needs. Additionally, they align Merrill and Bank of America products and services where appropriate. We will equip you with everything you need, as you move through the stages of development and move into the Merrill Financial Advisor role. During this stage of your journey, you will receive the necessary training and guidance through a defined path to become the financial advisor you want to be. You will have the opportunity to work with both affluent and high net worth clients, identifying needs, developing relationships, reviewing investment goals, and preparing investment recommendations that align with the goals of both existing and prospective clients. Once you have honed your skills and demonstrated success as an FSA, you typically will progress into the next stage of training and development as a Merrill Financial Solutions Advisor (MFSA). This role within the Advisor Development Program provides the opportunity to pursue a career within Merrill Wealth Management. The Academy will support you along the way with dedicated programs, tools and resources throughout your career journey. We’ll help you Build a successful career at Bank of America through world-class training and on-boarding programs that set you up for success.   • Mechanical/Electrical aptitude, including a basic understanding of electrical theory and electrical safety.

  • Ability to read electrical drawings and troubleshoot electrical systems; ability to diagnose malfunctioning electrical systems up to 240 VAC/870 VDC and perform preventive maintenance using electrical test equipment; ability to identify voltage systems that are above the level 240 VAC/870 VDC.

  • Comfortable using basic hand tools. Exposure to DCS programming and troubleshooting is beneficial.

  • Basic understanding of the paper-making process and process control preferred.

  • Travel up to 15% for training and assisting other sites as needed.

Monitor variances in costs versus headcount plans for both direct and subcontracted labor. Ensure proper allocation of costs and alignment vs headcount reporting. Provide allocation of new hires as per company reporting standards. Financial Planning and Analysis: Assist in the preparation and consolidation of financial statements for budgeting, forecasting, and medium-term planning. Conduct detailed financial analyses to support profitability assessments, margin optimization strategies, and variance analysis. Support the FP&A team in developing business review and strategy presentations and presenting financial insights and recommendations to senior management. Compliance and Reporting: Ensure compliance with company policies, financial regulations, and internal controls. Technical Skills: Budgeting, Forecasting, Controlling and SAP Financial Modeling Advanced Excel Variance Analysis Scenario Planning & Sensitivity Analysis Soft Skills Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Highest Level of analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Experience: 4-6 years in FP&A and Controlling roles

Welcome to Bosch. Whether in areas of automated mobility, Internet of Things, Smart Home solutions with innovative ideas we keep setting new standards to create integrated future. This is only possible with the help of a global network for more than 410,000 highly committed employees, with pioneers who break new technological ground every day. So why not join us in starting something remarkable? Your contribution to something big: You support the team in day-to-day operational and administrative activities within a Salesforce CRM and Conga CLM environment, helping to ensure stable business continuity during maternity coverage. You collaborate with business stakeholders and the remaining project team to gather, clarify, and document requirements, change requests, and operational needs. You create clear, concise, and actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, process descriptions, and documentation in alignment with business needs. You help structure and prioritize incoming business requests, ensuring transparency and efficient follow-up with stakeholders and delivery teams. You work in close partnership with consultants, developers, and product owners to support implementation activities, provide clarification, and track open topics to closure. You actively participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to backlog refinement, planning, reviews, and follow-up activities. You support user acceptance testing and regression testing by preparing test cases, coordinating feedback, documenting results, and following up on defects. You take care of structured stakeholder communication, including status updates, meeting preparation, minutes, and follow-up tracking. You prepare and maintain functional, process, and project documentation to keep information transparent and up to date. You support roll-out, onboarding, and training activities for business users, especially by preparing materials and coordinating support requests. You bring practical experience in agile project environments and are comfortable working with distributed, international teams. You are able to visualize, summarize, and present complex business and system topics in a clear and pragmatic way. What distinguishes you: A degree in Information Technology, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a comparable field. Practical experience as a Business Analyst, Consultant, or in a similar role in an IT project environment. Good understanding of CRM, sales, or contract-related business processes; experience with Salesforce CRM or CLM solutions is beneficial. Ability to gather, structure, and document requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process descriptions, and open topics in a clear and actionable way. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, consultants, developers, and product owners. Structured, reliable, and pragmatic working style, with the willingness to take ownership of operational and administrative tasks. Experience in agile project environments, ideally with knowledge of SAFe or similar agile frameworks. Ability to summarize, visualize, and present complex topics in a clear and understandable way. Fluent English skills. Additional experience that would be beneficial: Experience with Conga CLM or another Contract Lifecycle Management tool. Familiarity with Salesforce CRM administration or operational support activities. Basic familiarity with the Microsoft Power Platform toolset.

title: Business Controller
description: Jouw rol: de financiële sparringpartner van de business Als Business Controller rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CFO. Je bent de financiële partner voor de Business Line Managers en helpt hen de relatie te leggen tussen: commerciële ambities projectresultaten serviceprestaties capaciteit kosten en rendement strategische keuzes Je maakt complexe informatie concreet voor mensen die niet dagelijks met financiën werken. Goede business control gaat hier niet alleen over cijfers. Het gaat over begrijpen wat erachter zit en op tijd handelen. Waarom deze rol anders is: Dit is geen functie waarin je alleen rapportages maakt. Je zit dicht op de operatie en bent betrokken bij de keuzes die bepalen hoe Bosch presteert. Je werkt met: project- en serviceorganisaties technische en commerciële teams Business Line Managers projectcontrollers de CFO collega’s in Duitsland en binnen Bosch Je analyseert niet alleen afwijkingen, maar stelt ook de vraag: Wat moeten we nu doen om het resultaat te verbeteren? De context waarin jij werkt. Je standplaats is bij voorkeur Berkel en Rodenrijs, waar belangrijke financiële en operationele kennis van AFAS aanwezig is. Tegelijkertijd heeft Bosch ook een vestiging in Nieuwegein. Heb je een duidelijke voorkeur voor Nieuwegein? Dan bespreken we graag hoe we dit passend kunnen maken. In eerste instantie werk je voor een groot deel vanuit de gekozen hoofdlocatie om de organisatie, systemen en collega’s goed te leren kennen. Daarna ontstaat meer flexibiliteit voor hybride werken. Het inwerktraject wordt zorgvuldig ingericht. De huidige interim Business Controller en de CFO zorgen samen voor een uitgebreide overdracht en blijven beschikbaar voor vragen tijdens jouw eerste periode. Je begint dus niet alleen. Je krijgt begeleiding van mensen die de organisatie en financiële processen goed kennen. Jouw impact: Van financiële data naar duidelijke besluiten Planning en budgettering Begeleiden van het jaarlijkse budgetproces Ondersteunen van meerjarenplannen Opstellen en verbeteren van financiële modellen Vertalen van de bedrijfsstrategie naar concrete financiële doelstellingen Forecasting en resultaatbewaking Opstellen en onderhouden van doorlopende prognoses Analyseren van omzet, kosten, winstgevendheid en werkkapitaal Vergelijken van werkelijke resultaten met budget en prognose Verklaren van afwijkingen en signaleren van oorzaken Ontwikkelen van vroege signaleringen voor risico’s en kansen Analyse en rapportage Opstellen van heldere managementrapportages Maken van dashboards en stuurinformatie Uitvoeren van analyses voor project- en serviceorganisaties Benoemen van verbeterkansen en concrete vervolgstappen Ondersteunen van de CFO en het management met betrouwbare inzichten Business partnering en verbetering Fungeren als financieel sparringpartner voor Business Line Managers Vertalen van financiële informatie naar begrijpelijke acties Bevorderen van financieel bewustzijn in de organisatie Verbeteren van processen en datakwaliteit Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van financiële systemen en hulpmiddelen Jij zorgt dat de organisatie niet alleen weet wat er gebeurt, maar ook begrijpt waarom. Wat jij meebrengt: Must-haves Bachelor in Finance, Accountancy, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of vergelijkbaar Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in controlling, financiële analyse of planning Ervaring met project- of servicegerichte organisaties Gevorderde kennis van Excel Ervaring met ERP-systemen, bij voorkeur AFAS Nederlands is je eerste taal of je beheerst het vloeiend. De beheersing van het Engels is een vereiste. Sterk gewenst Ervaring met Power BI of vergelijkbare hulpmiddelen Ervaring in system integration, bouw of technische dienstverlening Kennis van projectresultaten, onderhanden werk en margesturing Inzicht in Nederlandse verslaggevingsregels Ervaring met het verbeteren van financiële processen Wie jij bent. Je ziet verbanden in complexe gegevens Je durft kritisch door te vragen Je communiceert helder Je bent zelfstandig en proactief Je werkt zorgvuldig en betrouwbaar Je kunt schakelen tussen detail en grote lijn Je krijgt energie van verbetering Jij bent niet iemand die alleen met cijfers werkt. Jij maakt cijfers waardevol voor mensen. Groei met Bosch mee. De organisatie ontwikkelt zich en jij krijgt de ruimte om daarin mee te groeien. Je hoeft niet alles al te beheersen. Wat wij belangrijk vinden, is dat je nieuwsgierig bent, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en wilt blijven leren.
location: Berkel en Rodenrijs, ZH, Netherlands

title: Business Controller - Costing and Controlling
description: The purpose of the role is to ensure timely closure of books and reporting, including variance analysis and cost control, responsible for forecasting, budgeting, complete audit coordination with the relevant stakeholders, and recommending actions to improve financial performance. title: Capital & Inventory Financial Analyst
description: The Capital & Inventory Controller is responsible for the financial oversight, reporting, analysis, and control of the Charleston Plant's inventory and capital assets for the VM division, ensuring accurate valuation, proper accounting treatment, and compliance with company policies and IFRS. Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, the Controller provides financial insights and analysis that support effective asset management, strong internal controls, operational performance, and informed business decisions. Through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement, this position helps maintain the accuracy and integrity of financial records while identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, accountability, and financial performance. Capital Expenditure Controlling Lead the end-to-end capital expenditure (CAPEX) controlling process for the division, ensuring effective financial planning, monitoring, reporting, and governance of capital investments. Manage the accounting and financial reporting of capital assets, including project capitalization, asset-in-service tracking, fixed asset records, month-end close activities, and compliance with company policies and IFRS. Monitor capital project performance against approved authorizations, budgets, and forecasts; analyze variances, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to management. Develop capital expenditure forecasts, annual budgets, and long-range investment plans to divisional objectives. Drive continuous improvement in capital planning, reporting, and internal control processes while supporting audit requirements and ensuring compliance with corporate governance standards. Inventory Controlling Lead all inventory controlling activities for the VM division, ensuring accurate valuation, financial reporting, reconciliation, and compliance with company policies and IFRS. Manage inventory accounting and month-end close processes, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, variance analysis, and reporting related to inventory balances, reserves, obsolescence, and working capital. Monitor inventory performance and analyze financial variances affecting cash flow, balance sheet accuracy, and asset utilization, providing actionable recommendations to management. Partner with Supply Chain and Operations teams to improve inventory accuracy, optimize working capital, and support operational planning and decision-making. Support physical inventory counts, cycle count programs, and inventory audit activities while maintaining strong internal controls and data integrity. Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to inventory processes, reporting accuracy, cost performance, and inventory optimization. Education Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field required. MBA, CMA, or equivalent professional certification a plus. Experience 2+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing finance, controlling, FP&A, or accounting. Experience with capital expenditure management and inventory accounting within manufacturing. Comprehensive understanding of manufacturing operations, cost accounting and financial reporting processes. Experience supporting month-end close and financial analysis activities. Experience working with ERP and reporting systems such as SAP, Hyperion Essbase, etc Core Competencies Financial analysis and business acumen. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Project management and organizational effectiveness. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Continuous improvement mindset. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong attention to detail and commitment to financial accuracy. Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive results through collaboration.

title: Senior Refinery Planning & Economics Analyst
description: Job Summary: We are looking for a Senior Analyst responsible for optimizing refining margin through the economic evaluation of crudes, products and operating configurations, and for developing and executing the production schedule. The role combines economic and financial modelling, linear programming (LP) optimization and close coordination across trading, refining, logistics and commercial teams, acting as the technical reference for the team and as a strategic partner to management. Key Responsibilities: Perform economic evaluations of crudes and feedstocks (assays, netbacks, differentials) and maintain valuation models to maximize refining margin. Build and update the LP model (PIMS) and the operating schedule (crude and unit scheduling, blending), aligned with sales, inventories and logistics constraints. Monitor crude, product and freight markets (Platts, Argus), identify arbitrage opportunities and margin risks, and support hedging decisions together with trading. Coordinate with Operations, Logistics, Trading and Commercial to ensure the plan is feasible and executed; track plan vs. actual performance and propose corrective actions. Support turnaround planning, assessing the economic impact and evaluating alternative supply and sales options. Produce executive reports and KPI dashboards (margins, yields, efficiency) and lead ad-hoc studies on new crudes and investment projects. Mentor and train junior analysts and contribute to the continuous improvement of the area's processes, models and tools. Requirements: Degree in Engineering (Chemical, Petroleum or Industrial), Economics or a related field; a postgraduate degree (MBA or a Master's in Finance or Energy) is a plus. 5–8 years of experience in oil economics, refinery planning or crude and products trading, within a refining or integrated energy company. Proven experience with linear programming software (Aspen PIMS, Haverly GRTMPS, RPMS or similar), assay management and refinery process economics. Advanced Excel/VBA skills; Python, SQL or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and market data platforms (Platts, Argus, S&P Global) are valued. Advanced English. Strong analytical skills. Executive communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

Role Purpose:

What will you do in this role? Our Forklift Operators are responsible for moving stock from one area to another within our warehouse environment. You’ll load and unload shipments of various sizes, and you may use certain types of equipment such as stand-up, sit-down, or clamp forklifts and electric pallet jacks.Our environment is team oriented, fast paced and safety focused. We move products that people need and want. At DHL, YOU will be an essential part of everyday life.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Load, unload, move, stock, and stage products and materials using various types of forklifts or other power equipment 80% of specified shift.
  • Pull and prepare product for shipment ensuring the exact number and types of product is loaded.
  • Keep appropriate records and reports for inventory accuracy.
  • Comply with all OSHA and MSDS standards.
  • Verify load accuracy; check the load count, stability, and product damage, report variances as necessary.
  • Change equipment battery or LP tank and monitor power source as necessary.
  • Maintain the facility’s equipment and materials in a neat, clean, and orderly fashion.
  • Assist in physical inventories.
  • Complete daily inspection of equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Forklift operator certificate or satisfactory completion of a forklift-training program within the first 30 days of employment
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent, preferred
  • Six months warehouse experience, preferred
  • Six months forklift operation experience

Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Customs Entry Writer
description:
Job Title: Customs Entry Writer
Location: Edison, NJ


Job Purpose:

As Customs Entry Writer, you will ensure compliance with federal and foreign regulations governing the shipment, receipt, and documentation of imported products while processing separate entries to Custom Border Patrol (US CUSTOMS). You will also compute tariffs (taxes), and price conversions of merchandise imported from foreign destinations. In addition, you will also be asked to examine various documents including invoices, bills of lading, and shipping statements to obtain release of incoming freight and resolve delays, all in line with business strategy and financial objectives, Group guidelines and policies. You will collaborate with internal teams (operations, sales, and procurement) and external partners (customers) to process customs entries, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and facilitating the efficient clearance of shipments, quickly and efficiently for our customer base.

If you are a dynamic and results-oriented professional with experience in managing national or global customers, we would love to hear from you! Join our team at Hillebrand Gori and contribute to our success in delivering 🌍 world-class logistics solutions 📦 to our valued customers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process documents through the Automated Commercial Environment (ACE) portal.
  • Process ACH Duty payments.
  • Handle CF28/CF29 requests for information.
  • Work closely with other departments to deliver high level of service to customers.
  • Maintain recordkeeping as required by US Customs rules and regulations.
  • Impeccable customer service.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Serve as the primary company customs representative for your customer account base, ensuring prompt response to customer inquiries and follow through on issues until resolution to customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate mastery with respect to the customs brokerage products’ standard operating procedures (SOP) and best practices.
  • Direct ownership of Customer Standard Operating Procedures and Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) databases for customer account base to ensure full compliance of CBP and customer requirements.
  • Develop the skill to serve as a custom’s trusted advisor, transitioning from the day-to-day data entry fundamentals to true customs brokerage account management of your clients.
  • Analyze and validate import documentation and data to ensure they are in accordance with all applicable laws and regulations prior to entry submission to U.S Customs and Partner Government Agencies (PGA).

Hillebrand Gori is seeking a commercially driven logistics leader to build and grow our business line in the US, focused on beverage packaging, ingredients, and non-alcoholic beverages. This is a high-impact commercial growth role for someone who enjoys developing new markets, building strategic customer relationships, shaping go-to-market strategy, and partnering closely with sales teams to turn opportunity into profitable business.

The role will initially focus on the US market, with the opportunity to expand into a broader Americas scope as the business grows. Commercial Strategy & Market Development

  • Identify market opportunities, customer segments, and priority accounts where Hillebrand Gori can expand its footprint.
  • Create local value propositions, sales playbooks, and go-to-market approaches tailored to customer and market needs.
  • Assess market trends, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics to continuously refine the commercial approach.


Business Development & Customer Growth


  • Drive new business development initiatives in partnership with the local sales team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

title: (Senior) Business Controller
description: We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated (Senior) Business Controller to join our team in Berlin on a two-year fixed-term contract . The Senior Business Controller position will support the Director and the department of Sales & Operation Germany (S&O GER), within the BU E-Mobility, with all business controlling tasks including month-end close preparation and reporting, plan-to-perform (business plan, forecast and KPIs follow-up) processes and ad-hoc financial analysis. Additionally, with your local controlling expertise, you will serve as an advisor towards the BU Controller of E-Mobility in specific or over-arching BU controlling topics. Key responsibilities & activities: Responsible for all business controlling topics concerning E-Mobility departments in S&O GER including but not limited to: Ensure the accuracy of the P&L structure ensuring financial data is correctly booked and aligned Drive month-end close through accrual preparation and coordination with accounting on key topics Prepare monthly management reporting, delivering clear insights on financial performance Actively participate in the S&O GER MT meetings by acting as a financial partner, challenging and supporting with business decisions Prepare financial forecasts by translating business input into accurate, forward-looking financials Lead the local business plan process together with local Management Team, ensuring alignment of financial goals Support in preparation and monitoring of KPIs to track business performance Support the local unit’s growth by advising on financial aspects of new initiatives, improvements and other strategic decisions As advisor to BU Controller you support and challenge BU controlling governance and run specific initiatives or ad-hoc analysis As (Senior) Business Controller E-Mobility you report to the Director of Business Control E-Mobility who is accountable for the overall controlling support of the Business unit. Location : Berlin Your profile and soft skills: Ideal candidate has 5+ years of experience within Business Controlling, Financial Analysis or Commercial Project Management Bachelor’s and ideally Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or similar education You are a team player and natural networker with experience from working in a challenging and high-paced business environment You have proven ability to establish trust and build relationships You are proactive, constructive and solution oriented You have strong excel and presentation skills, SAP experience You have high analytical skills with an eye for details Experience from utility business is a strong merit Full professional fluency in English and German is required

title: Commercial Manager (18-month temporary position)
description: As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. We are looking for a Commercial Manager to join our Commercial Operations team on a temporary full-time basis for 18 months . In this role, you will have end-to-end commercial responsibility for assigned offshore wind assets in Germany. Acting as the key commercial partner to Site Management, you will manage a broad range of operational contracts, drive commercial performance, and ensure contractual risks and opportunities are effectively managed. Working closely with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Asset Management, and external suppliers, you will help create commercial value, support efficient operations, and contribute to continuous improvement across the assets. What will you do? Commercial Management Partner with Site Management on commercial, contractual, and financial matters. Provide commercial analysis and recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions. Identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities. Support budgeting, forecasting, and performance reviews. Lead or support commercial negotiations and contract-related discussions. Contract Management Manage operational contracts throughout their lifecycle. Monitor supplier performance and compliance with contractual obligations. Handle contract variations, claims, and commercial disputes where required. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and key internal stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Drive improvements to commercial processes, reporting, and ways of working. Identify and implement value-creation and cost-saving opportunities. Promote best practices and share lessons learned across assets and functions. Who are you? You are a commercially driven professional with experience in contract and supplier management within a complex operational environment. You combine strong analytical skills with a pragmatic mindset and are comfortable working with both commercial details and broader business objectives. You build strong relationships, communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, and take ownership of delivering results. Structured and proactive by nature, you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift and no two days are the same. Next to this you bring: A degree in a commercial, legal, engineering or similar discipline Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract, commercial or procurement roles — preferably in renewables, energy, oil & gas, or other complex industries Experience interpreting, managing, supporting and negotiating commercial agreements supported by a strong commercial mindset Experience with operational renewable energy assets Ability to manage many tasks simultaneously with structure and prioritization Experience working with suppliers and external stakeholders Must be able to manage and negotiate contracts in English German language is a plus, not a must Location: Amsterdam (Netherlands), Kolding or Copenhagen (Denmark), Hamburg (Germany) or London (UK)

title: Financial Business Partner / Business Controller
description: Som Financial Business Partner har du en central roll i att stödja och utmana verksamheten i både operativa och strategiska frågor. Du arbetar nära ledningsgruppen inom ditt ansvarsområde och bidrar med finansiella insikter som skapar förutsättningar för välgrundade affärsbeslut och långsiktig värdeskapande utveckling. I rollen ansvarar du bland annat för att driva och samordna budget- och prognosprocesser samt säkerställer hög kvalitet och träffsäkerhet i verksamhetens ekonomiska planering. Genom att analysera resultat, identifiera trender, risker och möjligheter samt omsätta finansiell data till konkreta rekommendationer bidrar du till välgrundade beslut som skapar värde för verksamheten. Du följer upp mål, nyckeltal och prestationer för att säkerställa att verksamheten utvecklas i linje med uppsatta ambitioner. Du fungerar som en proaktiv affärspartner som stöttar, vägleder och utmanar chefer i ekonomiska och affärsmässiga frågor, samtidigt som du bidrar till att driva verksamheten framåt. Ditt arbete präglas av nära samarbete med verksamheten där du förväntas bidra med både perspektiv, initiativkraft och affärsmässighet. Som medlem i ledningsgruppen för ditt område har du en aktiv roll och bidrar med ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv. Du är trygg i att presentera ekonomiska analyser och rekommendationer för seniora beslutsfattare och har förmågan att göra komplex information tydlig och relevant. Du blir en del av ett engagerat controllerteam som präglas av ett öppet och prestigelöst arbetssätt där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och olika perspektiv bidrar till både individuellt lärande och gemensamma resultat. Vi söker dig som har Akademisk examen inom ekonomi eller motsvarande Minst 5 års erfarenhet i rollen som Financial Business Partner, Business Controlling eller annan kvalificerad ekonomistyrning Jobbat nära ledningsgrupper och stöttat beslutsfattande genom finansiell analys och affärsmässig rådgivning Erfarenhet av att driva budget-, prognos- och uppföljningsprocesser Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och PowerPoint Som person är du analytisk och datadriven med förmåga att växla mellan helhetsperspektiv och detaljer. Du är affärsorienterad, strategisk och trivs med att omsätta analyser till konkreta rekommendationer som skapar värde för verksamheten. Du bygger förtroende genom ett prestigelöst arbetssätt, god samarbetsförmåga och positiv energi. Du har lätt för att bygga relationer och är trygg i att presentera dina slutsatser, samtidigt som du är lyhörd för verksamhetens behov. Vi söker framför allt en nyfiken och engagerad person som vill vara med och utveckla verksamheten. Om du dessutom har ett intresse för system, digitalisering och verksamhetsutveckling kommer du att trivas hos oss, särskilt då vi befinner oss i en spännande förändringsresa med implementeringen av SAP S/4HANA.
location: Solna, Stockholm County, Sweden

We’re looking for a passionate individual to help us harness the power of the wind to change the world for the better. Join us to find your element working for fossil freedom. As a Senior Business Controller for our Business Area (BA) Wind team, you will play a pivotal role in driving financial performance and strategic decision-making by translating finance into business strategy. Be in your element with BA Wind Our wind, solar and batteries business offers a unique opportunity to be in your element working to help harness the forces which will take us to fossil freedom. As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. Overall purpose of the role: We are seeking a highly motivated and analytically strong professional to join our organisation within Business Area Wind. In this position you will strengthen and further develop the reporting and planning process in BA Wind. The role combines structured financial expertise with a hands-on approach to deliver high-quality financial data and insights that support decision-making. Close collaboration with the business and Vattenfall Group functions is essential, as well as actively contributing to improvements across controlling, processes, and systems. The Senior Business Controller is responsible for the following main tasks: Ensuring that a sound planning & control system is in place within BA Wind. Our ideal candidate is positioned at an advanced stage of their professional finance career, demonstrating stakeholder management and the ability to communicate financial topics in an approachable way, while remaining eager to learn and excel within an international setting. As our Senior Business Controller, you will bring: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in controlling, economics, accounting or finance 8+ years in finance, leading planning/control cycles and performance management for business segments Experience working across complex financial systems and data sources, with the ability to translate data into clear insights Strong skills in IBM TM1, Cognos Controller, Power BI and Office 365 Professional finance qualification such as CIMA/CGMA, ACA, ACCA, RA, RC or an equivalent certification is considered an advantage. A big part of your work will center around cybersecurity. You’ll define modern firewall rulesets built on IEC 62443 and zero‑trust principles, validate safe communication paths for industrial protocols like Modbus, and take full responsibility for the lifecycle of our OT firewalls. That includes firmware updates, patching strategies, redundancy testing, vendor coordination, and the automated deployment of configurations across our global BESS fleet using FortiManager. You’ll also play a hands-on role in our production environments—diving into troubleshooting, leading root‑cause analysis, and contributing to cybersecurity assessments and audits that strengthen our defenses. Collaboration will be at the heart of your everyday work. You’ll partner with engineering teams at our assembly plants to ensure firewalls are configured correctly from the moment a unit is built, and you’ll work with Digital/IT teams to define secure, future‑proof IT–OT demarcation points. Along the way, you’ll also share your expertise with junior engineers and project teams, helping them grow while raising the overall technical bar. Leads cross-functional P&C projects and pillars end-to-end, coordinating CoEs, leaders and stakeholders. Role models leadership, inclusion, collaboration and commercial judgement. Organisation Effectiveness: Lead OE priorities including design, simplification, productivity, role clarity and ways-of-working for a future-fit business. Commercial Partnership: Translate business strategy into people priorities, using insight, data and commercial judgement to drive performance and growth. Projects & Change: Lead end-to-end P&C projects and change initiatives through clear governance, stakeholder engagement and adoption. The required qualifications for this role are: Proven senior HRBP experience partnering Executive members and senior leadership teams in a complex, matrixed environment. Deep generalist capability across talent, OE, culture, leadership, performance and change. Experience leading end-to-end people projects or strategic HR pillars with measurable business

From strategy to business transformation and ensuring operational and regulatory compliance. We are searching for a structured, self-driven and enterprising person to make a difference within Financial Markets.

As a business development manager working within the Business Development & Governance team, you will be part of the Markets Products organization within Financial Markets. Within these areas of responsibility, you will:

• Write and establish product strategies and roadmaps together with product owners, ensuring alignment to strategic frameworks

• Drive and follow up on business transformation and development activities together with relevant business stakeholders and the IT development teams

• Manage and develop trade lifecycle processes by ensuring controls to mitigate identified risks and updated processes and documentation

• Drive and manage product lifecycle management activities including ensuring updated product information, risk assessments, governance activities etc

• Support senior leadership with ad-hoc strategic analysis, decision material, workshops and management forums.

What is needed in this role:

• Background in management consulting, with a well-developed consulting skill set (“consulting toolbox”), including experience preparing senior stakeholder materials and driving complex projects while facilitating decisions on senior level

• Previous experience of working within capital markets and a good understanding of markets products, i.e., Fixed Income, Credits, FX, Equities and DCM

• Good understanding of regulations applied to market products, e.g., MIFID 2

• Hands-on and pragmatic mindset, comfortable moving between strategy, execution and detail

• Structured and driven personality with ability to adopt a versatile work-setting mindset, putting in the work when needed to meet deadlines

• Excellent stakeholder management and change management skills

• Relevant university degree, MSc or similar in engineering, finance, economics or business

With us, you can experience:

  • Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

  • Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

  • An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

  • A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

  • Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden.
